sum: Hindustan Construction Company Limited has filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) regarding a substantial acquisition of shares, triggering takeover code obligations on the acquiror.
detail: The disclosure was filed with NSE on or around 8 May 2026 (per NSE archive timestamp) and reflects compliance with mandatory disclosure requirements under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Regulation 31(4) requires any person acquiring shares of a listed company to disclose the acquisition to the stock exchange within two days of crossing the 5% threshold. HCC is a major infrastructure and construction player; the acquiror's identity and the quantum of shares acquired are material details that would be contained in the full PDF filing.
